request_mainline: caller supplies Freehand runtime home and current working directory
loader resolves global instruction authoring inputs from `~/.freehand/AGENTS.md` and `~/.freehand/skills`
loader resolves local instruction authoring inputs from every directory between project root and cwd using `AGENTS.md` and `.agents/skills`
discovered authoring files are validated and normalized into typed manifest entries
response_mainline: manifest entries carry scope, precedence, normalized path, content byte count, and content hash
skill entries also carry parsed `name` and `description`
optional writer persists the compiled manifest to `~/.freehand/state/instructions/capability-manifest.json`
error_mainline: cwd that is not a directory is rejected
unreadable AGENTS or skill files become explicit read errors
malformed skill frontmatter becomes an explicit manifest error while valid capability entries remain visible
manifest write failure returns an explicit error

shared_functions.purpose: discover, validate, sort, and fingerprint AGENTS.md and skill authoring surfaces into one manifest
related_tests: global/local AGENTS and skills indexing tests
shared_functions.why_shared: instruction capability discovery must not be duplicated in runtime, UI, or provider crates

shared_functions.purpose: persist the compiled manifest under runtime state
shared_functions.why_shared: manifest output path and JSON shape must stay single-sourced

call_table.responsibility: build compile input with default project-root markers
discover global and local AGENTS.md plus skill roots
normalize one AGENTS.md source into a manifest entry
call_table.input_semantic: AGENTS.md path plus scope plus precedence
skill root plus scope plus precedence

call_table.output_semantic: skill name and description or manifest error

call_table.responsibility: persist manifest JSON under runtime state

sync_status: first manifest compiler is implemented in `crates/freehand-instructions`
current support covers global `~/.freehand/AGENTS.md`, local `AGENTS.md`, global `~/.freehand/skills`, and local `.agents/skills`
runtime/context planner consumption is pending and must be added through this manifest owner
